## Module info
- Title: {{TITLE}}
- Scope: {{SCOPE}}
- Child modules: {{CHILDREN}}

## Files to write (each is a short doc, in English, keeping technical nouns verbatim)
1. `overview.md` —— one or two sentences: what this module is and its role in the repository (example style: *graphiti_core is the shared Python kernel; docker-compose orchestrates the three runtime services — REST server, MCP server, and the Next.js web UI.*)
2. `tech-stack.md` —— one paragraph listing the key languages/frameworks/build tools/storages.
3. `architecture.md` —— 3~6 bullets on internal structure and external contracts (call chains, orchestration entry points, cross-process contracts).
4. `configuration-and-commands.md` —— one paragraph with this module's specific run/build/debug commands (if none: "no special commands, see the root README").
5. `coding-conventions.md` (optional) —— only if the module has clear, consistent coding conventions: 3~5 bullets.

## Requirements
- Read the key files under scope before writing; content must match the real code.
- No heading levels (these are fragment docs — plain text/bullets only).
- Keep it tight: overview 1~2 sentences, tech stack 1~3 sentences, architecture 3~6 bullets.
